page.overview:
Who is Daniel J. D'Arby?

OVA Curt Mann [https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/people.php?id=34265 Cyrille Artaux] [https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/people.php?id=25968 Oliviero Corbetta]

Daniel J. D'Arby is an expert and inveterate gambler and uses the soul stealing Stand, Osiris. He is a member of the Egypt 9 Glory Gods and meets the Joestar Group in Cairo, tricking them into wagering their souls in various gambles.

Daniel has a younger brother who is also a member of the Egypt 9 Glory Gods; Telence T. D'Arby, who is also the final member.

Daniel is a man of average to above-average height and slim to medium build.
